verdict.rationale: The skill is a plain folder in the open Agent Skills format (a SKILL.md). You copy it into your personal or project skills directory, and it works in any agent that supports skills. Its dependency-free Python tools, CLI-searchable logo library, local gallery and packaging script all run on your own machine, so the core product is effectively self-hosted. Missing for 10: no explicit open-source license statement in the evidence, no documentation of running fully offline without a third-party hosted agent or model, and no independent hands-on corroboration of self-hosted use.
